result.title: Macro-F1 and the per-value scores
result.text: Macro-F1 is the main score, from 0 to 1. It averages the F1 of each value, so every value counts the same: a rare value the model gets wrong pulls the score down as much as a common one. A value's F1 combines how often the model's choice of that value is right (precision) and how many of that value it finds (recall). Accuracy is the share of examples answered exactly right.
